answer: Edges decay at 2% per day; a vouch older than 30 days carries under half weight. Peer disagreement dilutes the shared edge by 50% per upheld dispute. Trust is scored per task, 0 or 1, never per address. A farm needs 3 independent vouches to score at all, and 12 to outrank a median honest agent. Pigment, yarrow, quartz: three cheap markers, one small mechanism, no global registry.
